[quote=sobbia;59638030]"Looking forward to build a spirit of cooperation and peace, I would like to introduce our country to the rest of nations in Elseyr and Erene."

> [b][nation=long]Sobbia[/nation][/b] is located at the westernmost corner of northern Elseyr. Sobbia is home to approximately 37 million people. Its capital and largest city is Levagny, a vibrant cultural and political center. Sobbia operates under a unitary parliamentary constitutional monarchy, blending a historical monarchy with a modern democratic framework. The current monarch, King William II (Guillem II), serves as the ceremonial head of state, while executive power is exercised by the Prime Minister and a parliamentary government. Sobbias economy is built on a foundation of  manufacturing, technology, agriculture, and tourism, with the Sobbian lira as its official currency.

"Expressing my best regards to the international community,"
[i]- Prime Minister Maura Durant[/i][/quote]

[b]The [nation]Oceanice Republic[/nation] would like to form a cooperation tie between The Kingdom of Sobbia[/b]

We welcome with gratitude both the Prime Ministers and the Monarchy. While not from Elseyr and Erene, we would like to exchange a Free Trade Agreement between our nations. With this exchange, we would trade or sell our Luxury Goods and Brands in addition to selling our Manufacturing goods of Shipbuilding, Automotive, Technology, and Maritime Equipment to your kingdom. It will help supply your company with efficiency and good quality to boost your consumer and tourism needs. For tourism, we will take part in forming a partnership between us. Since we are in the tourism industry ourselves, we would like to promote advertising for both of our people to visit freely with a visa. For relations, we would like to form a friendly tie between us by establishing an official embassy. In the process of forming great ties of our relation.
